_doc: Learner-model parameters (SIMULATION_SPEC.md sections 7 and 7.7). Every entry is {value, range, source}. 'range' is used by EXP-S (one-at-a-time low/high); null means not swept. Keys starting with '_' are documentation and are ignored by code. Symbols in the spec: guess = g, slip = s, l_p = ell_p, l_r = ell_r.

S.source: design: weekly sessions, one school semester

rt_baseline_seconds.source: stylised; only relative response times matter for the algorithm

s_D.source: design choice: logit per difficulty level, so D in [1,5] spans +/-2 logits; delta = s_D*(D - 3)

guess.source: BKT guess bound (Baker et al., 2008); low for open answers

slip.source: BKT slip bound (Baker et al., 2008; Corbett & Anderson, 1994)

sigma_rt.source: lognormal response-time model (van der Linden, 2006); value stylised

lambda_d.source: lognormal response-time model (van der Linden, 2006): harder relative to ability -> slower; value stylised

dk_scale.source: stylised; multiplies dk0, dk1 and dk2

dk_max.source: stylised; upper clip of the 'don't know' probability

dk_rt_factor.source: stylised; response time of a 'don't know' answer relative to a normal attempt

l_p.source: stylised; ability gain per attempted task; checked in EXP-CAL

l_r.source: stylised; extra gain after a correct retry; checked in EXP-CAL

rho.source: stylised; per-task reversion to trait engagement

rho_s.source: stylised; per-week reversion to trait engagement

phi_flow.source: direction from affect dynamics (D'Mello & Graesser, 2012; Baker et al., 2010); magnitude stylised

phi_bore.source: direction from affect dynamics (Baker et al., 2010); magnitude stylised

phi_frus.source: direction from affect dynamics (D'Mello & Graesser, 2012); magnitude stylised

band_lo.source: target challenge band; also used by the TIB metric (never shifted for the metric)

band_hi.source: upper bound near the 85% rule (Wilson et al., 2019)

band_shift.source: sensitivity only: shifts the learner's engagement band, not the TIB metric

E_q.source: stylised; engagement level below which quitting becomes possible

q_max.source: stylised; maximum quit probability per task

a0.source: stylised; attend probability = clip(a0 + a1*E, 0, attend_max)

absences_to_churn.source: stylised; consecutive absences after which the learner never returns

grader_error.source: LLM grader disagreement; Report 5 H1 targets kappa >= 0.60

gain_scale.source: multiplies the scenario gains (configs/scenarios.json); anchor: feedback effect d ~ 0.48 (Wisniewski et al., 2020) ~ 0.87 logits (Chinn, 2000)
